operations.title: Constant-numerator labelled primitives do not close the five-site projective derivative through scalar degree three
operations.summary: At primes 1009 and 1013 the primitive rank is 358 and each F' block contributes all d+1 dimensions for d=0,1,2,3; this excludes only the constant-numerator labelled sector.

operations.title: Nima handoff: labelled order-one constant-numerator exclusion
operations.body: The correctly typed order-one test used 180 source terms x 3 fiber directions = 540 labelled primitive columns. Across primes 1009 and 1013 their rank is 358; adjoining F' contributes the full d+1 dimensions for scalar degrees d=0..3. Thus no order-one relation exists in the constant-numerator labelled sector. This does not imply large GM rank. The next admissible enlargement is source-derived numerator labels while retaining the same occurrence-labelled pole filtration.

authority_basis.summary: Operator directed Nima to continue the sharp five-site projective program; this records verified owned computation.
